a.format.text_fn_name.moved: The pinned GAP was `format.text_fn_name:validates:bin-identical:text-parse-refused` — the module VALIDATED and was bin-identical, and only the text leg refused, because the name (a function name, `m::dep_clamp`) leaves the bare-identifier alphabet and text had no escape for it. trust-ir's WS4.3 identifier half prints `@"escaped"` and `Parser::read_name` decodes it, so the name is carried rather than laundered and the text codec round-trips it byte-identically. The refusal was CORRECT while the spelling was missing; the fix carries the field instead of relaxing the check.
